play.shell.exitText: Your progress in this game will be lost.
play.games.memory.title: Memory Cards
play.games.memory.description: Find every pair using as few moves as possible.
play.games.memory.how: Flip two cards. Matching symbols stay visible.
play.games.reaction.title: Reaction Test
play.games.reaction.description: Measure your reflexes over five quick rounds.
play.games.reaction.how: Wait for the area to turn green, then tap it as quickly as possible.
play.games.color.title: Color Match
play.games.color.description: Quickly identify the actual color of the text.
play.games.color.how: Choose the ink color without being misled by the displayed word.
play.games.color.accessible: Also show the color name for accessible mode
play.games.bubble.title: Bubble Pop
play.games.bubble.description: Match bubbles and clear the board.
play.games.bubble.how: Aim with the trajectory and tap to shoot. Groups of three or more matching bubbles disappear.
play.games.brick.title: Brick Smash
play.games.brick.description: Break every brick across three original levels.
play.games.brick.how: Move the paddle with touch or mouse. Tap to launch the ball and protect your three lives.
play.games.tower.title: Tower Stack
play.games.tower.description: Build the tallest tower, one block at a time.
play.games.tower.how: Tap at the right moment to stack the moving block. The game ends when you miss the tower.
play.games.penalty.title: Penalty Master
play.games.penalty.description: Score or save as many penalties as possible.
play.games.penalty.how: Choose Striker or Keeper, then tap the left, middle or right zone. You have five attempts.
play.games.snake.title: Snake
play.games.snake.description: Grow the snake without hitting the walls or its tail.
play.games.snake.how: Use arrow keys, WASD, swipe or the touch pad. Eat the orange dots to grow.
